mood: A nocturnal relief interrupted by measured color.
lighting: Self-luminous cool white and faint lavender peaks against deep black; saturated contour accents stay thin, sharp, and restrained.
negative_constraints: No legible words, logos, or interface labels.
No literal garden, flowers, instruments, or waveform/equalizer UI.
No cards, panels styled as summaries, dashboards, desks, or realistic props.
No continuous rainbow gradients or uniform all-over scanlines.
Keep the upper-right open and dark; preserve abrupt black interruptions.
no equal-weight grid of source objects
no unrelated replacement image or metaphorical scene when a source image is attached
